title: Shared definitions of the memory ledger
description: The record, reflection, alias and compaction-details shapes every ledger entry uses. Source: memory/ledger/types.go (Observation, Reflection, MemoryDetails, ConsolidationReport, ObservationFrom, ReflectionFrom, MemoryDetailsFrom), memory/ledger/aliases.go (SubjectAlias), memory/ids/ids.go (HashID).

recordId.description: A record or reflection id: the first 12 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the record's identity (ids.HashID); ledger.MemoryIDPattern.

entryId.description: A session entry id: a harness transcript's own id, a Pi/PiG entry id, or a neutral-store id ("om" and 8 hex digits, neutral/host.go newID). Readers require it non-empty.

observation.description: One record (ledger.Observation): a value or evidence record level 0 reads from tool output (record-tool-output.schema.json), or a record of any other kind.

observationRecord.description: One record (ledger.Observation) of any kind but value and evidence. The six kernel members are required (ObservationFrom refuses the record without them); the rest are optional and read leniently: a malformed optional member is cleared, not fatal. Writers emit no other member.

timestamp.description: When the source was said, as level 0 writes it ("YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM" in the source's time) or as a v1 worker wrote it; any non-empty string loads.

kind.description: ObservationKindValues and CodeKindValues but value and evidence (record-tool-output.schema.json).

scope.description: The qualifier that tells two figures apart; besides free text it may name where the record holds: session, project:<repoId>, user or global (ledger.Scope*). Old values keep loading and keep their meaning.

fields.description: Values of the fields a model's note schema adds, by field name.

origin.description: Who wrote the record under memory v2; absent for a v1 worker's record.

respondsTo.description: The user's claims a pushback record (kind pushback) answers (contracts/encoding.md, "Pushback").

source.description: Where the record's text came from, set by code from the transcript role and tool of its first source entry (ledger.SourceValues; contracts/encoding.md). Absent on records written before phase 2.

authority.description: How far the record is trusted, from its source; level 1 only lowers it (ledger.AuthorityValues, highest first).

hedge.description: How the record's own sentence states it, by the code lexicon (ledger.HedgeOf; contracts/encoding.md, contracts/encoding.jsonl); contested for a user claim the assistant pushed back on ("Pushback").

timeHint.description: after:<date> for a plan, before:<date> for a reported past event with no event date (ledger.TimeHintOf).

episode.description: The id of the record's episode: ledger.EpisodeID of the session and the request that opened it (contracts/encoding.md, "Episode").

recordKeys.description: The exact strings a record can be looked up by (ledger.Keys), each list in found order without repeats; empty lists are omitted.

recordFrame.description: Where in a repository the record was made (ledger.Frame): the adapter's repository id, branch and HEAD (host.Repo), and the repository-relative path, symbol and body hash it is about. Empty members are omitted.

recordWriter.description: Who wrote the record (ledger.Writer): the harness, its session id, the session model's key, and the engine. Empty members are omitted.

reflection.description: A durable conclusion (ledger.Reflection); content is one line (ReflectionFrom refuses a newline).

subjectAlias.description: ledger.SubjectAlias: from and to are subjects (normalized on read); an alias with either empty is skipped.

consolidationReport.description: ledger.ConsolidationReport: what memory v2's level-1 request did at one compaction. Counts are omitted when zero.

memoryDetails.description: The details of a compaction the engine wrote (ledger.MemoryDetails, type om.folded): the full folded projection, whatever the summary text shows. v1 wrote foldThroughEntryId when it moved the cut (its fold boundary differs from firstKeptEntryId); v2 writes engine "v2" and keeps the host's cut.

foldThroughEntryId.description: The entry through which the summary folded the ledger (ledger.LatestFullFoldBoundaryID reads it before firstKeptEntryId). Readers accept null as absent.

customEntry.description: The envelope of a custom session entry, as Pi/PiG (AppendEntry) and the neutral store (neutral/host.go appendEntry) write it. Members a host adds beyond these are allowed.
